project_name: Consultant AI - The Crystal Strategy Room

key_principles: Glass is Truth: Use transparency to show depth and connection.
Data is Beautiful: Analytics should look like art, not spreadsheets.
Motion is Meaning: Things don't just appear; they flow into existence.
Contrast is King: Deep darks vs. glowing accents.

headings.usage: All H1-H3 headings. Use font-weight 600 or 700.
headings.notes: Adds a layer of 'Consulting Prestige' to the tech interface.

body.weights: Light (300) for large text, Regular (400) for standard.

data.usage: Numbers, charts, code snippets, AI reasoning logs.

glassmorphism.css: backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);

texture.noise: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")
texture.usage: Overlay on the main background to reduce digital flatness.

rules: Widgets: Mix of col-span-3, col-span-6, col-span-4 based on importance.

marketing.structure: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 p-8 md:p-12

rules: Central Topic: Absolute center, pulsing glow.
Agents: Arranged radially around the center.
Debate Stream: Floating glass panel on the right.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-input hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-3
buttons.glass: bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-foreground transition-all rounded-full px-6 py-2

cards.glass: rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-lg shadow-xl

inputs.style: bg-background/50 border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg

hero_background.alt: Abstract geometric glass shapes in blue and purple
hero_background.usage: Landing page hero background, subtle opacity.

consulting_room_bg.usage: Background for the 'Consulting' page, heavily blurred.

motion_guidelines.micro_interactions: Active states must have immediate feedback (scale 0.98 on click).

accessibility_rules.contrast: Ensure text on glass backgrounds has sufficient contrast. Use text-shadow if necessary.
accessibility_rules.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-research-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update tailwind.config.js to use the new color palette and fonts.
2. Create a global 'glass-panel' utility class in index.css.
3. Implement the 'Control Room' layout for the Dashboard.
4. Build the 'Consulting Room' using the radial layout strategy.
5. Ensure Dark/Light mode toggle works and persists preference.
6. Use the provided image URLs for backgrounds and avatars.
7. DO NOT use generic 'Inter' for headings; use 'Playfair Display'.
8. Add data-testid to all buttons, inputs, and links.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts.
Spacing: Use p-8 or p-12 where you'd normally use p-4.
Dark Mode: Don't just invert colors; make it 'Premium Night Mode'.
Glassmorphism: It must look like 'Milled Crystal', not 'Dirty Plastic'.
